Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: [Updated] The login-time onboarding gate always re-routes a Trainer account to the step matching its current status/agreement/payout state, never straight to the Trainer Dashboard until every step is done.
column3: 1. Log in as a Trainer whose profile is PENDING_VERIFICATION with no trainerType set yet - confirm landing on "Teach on HanGo" type-selection. 2. Repeat for PENDING_VERIFICATION with a trainerType already chosen but agreementSigned=false - confirm landing on the E-Cooperation Agreement screen (NOT "Complete Teaching Profile"). 3. Repeat for PENDING_VERIFICATION with trainerType chosen AND agreementSigned=true - confirm landing on "Complete Teaching Profile". 4. Repeat for AWAITING_APPROVAL, SUSPENDED, and PENDING_VERIFICATION-with-adminNotes - confirm each lands on the read-only Application Status screen. 5. Repeat for VERIFIED with agreementSigned=false - confirm landing on the E-Cooperation Agreement screen again (rare fallback path; normally agreementSigned is already true by the time a profile reaches VERIFIED, since it's now signed before submission). 6. Repeat for VERIFIED+agreementSigned=true with an empty bank account - confirm landing on Payout & Identity Info. 7. Repeat for VERIFIED+agreementSigned=true+bank account set - confirm landing on the real Trainer Dashboard.
column4: Every login re-evaluates the profile and routes to exactly the step described in each sub-case; the Trainer Dashboard is reached only in sub-case 7. The routing logic lives in login_page.dart's _checkStatusAndRouteForLogin.
column5: Trainer test accounts pre-seeded at each of the seven states above (or one account walked through them sequentially).
